summary: Computes the collision contact-constraint response for a rigid body (vehicle): takes the contact point a2 relative to the body world position (this+0x4/0xC/0x14), combines it with coefficient terms (this+0x64..0x8C), writes the contact-motion component along the normal a3 to *a4, evaluates an impulse-correction scalar *a5 from the world inertia tensor (this+0xEC..0x12C) plus bias term (this+0xB4), and optionally writes the body-space contact offset a6 when non-null. Returns the contact normal pointer a3.

operations.description: Compute contact offset components v6/v7/v9 = a2 - body world position (this+0x4/0xC/0x14).
Combine each offset component with a coefficient row and base term: v17 = v6*this+0x7C + this+0x64; v18 = v7*this+0x84 + this+0x6C; v19 = v9*this+0x8C + this+0x74.
Write scalar contact-motion component along normal: *a4 = v17*a3[0] + v18*a3[1] + v19*a3[2].
Cross product of contact offset and normal: v10 = v7*a3[2] - v9*a3[1]; v11 = v9*a3[0] - v6*a3[2]; v12 = v6*a3[1] - v7*a3[0].
Apply world inertia tensor row 0 to the cross-product terms: v14 = v12*this+0xEC + v11*this+0xF4 + v10*this+0xFC.
Apply world inertia tensor row 1: v15 = v12*this+0x104 + v11*this+0x10C + v10*this+0x114.
Apply world inertia tensor row 2: v16 = v12*this+0x11C + v11*this+0x124 + v10*this+0x12C.
Write impulse-correction scalar *a5 = (v15*v9 - v16*v7)*a3[0] + (v16*v6 - v9*v14)*a3[1] + (v7*v14 - v15*v6)*a3[2] + this+0xB4 (bias term).
Guard on optional output a6: body-space contact offset is written only when a6 is non-null.
Write body-space contact offset: *a6 = v17 - *a4*a3[0]; a6[1] = v18 - *a4*a3[1]; a6[2] = v19 - *a4*a3[2].

v16 = v12 * this[0x11C] + v11 * this[0x124] + v10 * this[0x12C];
